description: This file defines the 'Delete' feature for managing followers within the Conduit project, specifically handling the removal of a follower relationship by username. It includes command validation, and a handler that interacts with the database context to remove follower relationships and retrieve the updated profile.

classes.name: Delete.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates that the username provided in the command is neither null nor empty.

classes.name: Delete.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the delete follower request by removing the follower relationship and returning the updated profile.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the delete command by locating the target and observer users, removing the follower link if it exists, and returning the updated profile.
